agenda_text:
BOARD OF EXAMINERS, APPEALS AND
  CONDEMNATION AGENDA
  MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 15, 2025
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  QUEEN MARY CONFERENCE ROOM, 4TH FLOOR, 1:30 PM

Janet Lipson, Chair  Erin Hoops, Member
Steve Askin, Vice Chair  Joseph Hower, Member
Ismar Enriquez, Member  Ethel Powers, Member

Angel Arredondo, Bureau Manager  Nicholas Masero, Deputy City Attorney
Myeesha Ayala, Secretary  Scott Baldwin, Acting Code Enforcement Officer

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  LBCD@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56501  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Board of Examiners, Appeals and
  Condemnation meeting of Monday, August 18, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56500  Recommendation to conclude the hearing, adopt the findings of the Building
  Official as the Board's findings, determine that the one-story single family dwelling
  with an attached 2-car garage located at 5911 Linden Avenue is substandard and
  a public nuisance, and order the owners to demolish or rehabilitate the structure as
  per Findings dated September 15, 2025 by October 15, 2025. Also, order the
  owners to maintain the structure in a safe, clean and secure manner until the
  demolition or rehabilitation is complete.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  25-56502  Recommendation to discuss prospective dates and times to receive and file a
  presentation on the Ralph M. Brown Act, Robert's Rules of Order, and the role of
  the Board from the City Attorney’s Office.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56503  Recommendation to receive and file Manager’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT
